assets.prompt:

assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Landscape social sharing card for a wedding website; 1536x800, approximately 1200x630 ratio; legible in a WhatsApp preview.
Primary request: High-quality bespoke wedding stationery typography, simple art-directed spacious composition.
Scene/backdrop: Warm ivory paper background #f8f4ed with very subtle fine paper grain.
Style/medium: Refined editorial wedding stationery with typography and delicate champagne fine rules.
Color palette: Warm ivory #f8f4ed, deep burgundy #65263b type, muted champagne fine rules.
Composition/framing: Spacious centered horizontal card. Small widely spaced sans-serif announcement near upper center. Large elegant editorial high-contrast serif couple names as the prominent central focal point. Date and location centered below in refined small spaced lettering with sufficient size for social previews. Thin discreet champagne rules above and below the date/location block.
Text (verbatim; exact spelling and punctuation):
"WE ARE GETTING MARRIED"
"Christy & Amala"
"SUNDAY, 03 JANUARY 2027"
"PATHANAMTHITTA, KERALA"
Constraints: Render these four lines only, each once. Couple names most prominent. No people, no stock couples, no hearts, no florals, no excessive gold, no other text, no logos or watermarks.
assets.inspection: Accepted first attempt. All four required text lines accurately rendered. Burgundy serif names prominent on ivory paper; fine champagne rules. No people, hearts, or florals.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: flat blank luxury wedding invitation artwork for a website, portrait 1024x1536. Extraordinary royal ivory-and-gold blank invitation card artwork. Warm ivory handmade paper with a delicate embossed antique gold ornamental frame, symmetrical finely engraved acanthus and filigree, tasteful ornate ornamental crest at top center, refined gilded cornerwork, incredibly fine linework. Thin layered gold border around edges with generous internal clear space. Flat straight-on full bleed card surface, no perspective. The CENTRAL 65% WIDTH by 72% HEIGHT must be entirely plain empty ivory negative space for live website text. Keep all ornaments at the perimeter. Frame is symmetrical and remarkably refined. Photoreal luxury letterpress stationery; tactile warm ivory paper, realistic shallow antique gold embossing, exquisite fine engraved lines, soft shadows from gold embossing, elegant warm light. ONE image only. No text, no letters, no crowns, no religious symbols, no diamonds, no mockup table, no objects beyond card. No curtains inside this asset. Do not place any ornament inside the large central blank area.
assets.inspection: Accepted first attempt. Fine gold filigree perimeter and embossed crest on ivory paper. Empty center for accessible live HTML text. Optimized to 900x1350 WebP.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent photographic ribbon overlay for a modern luxury website entrance. ONE photoreal champagne-gold silk satin ribbon tied in a refined elegant bow, with long straight horizontal ribbon bands reaching the full left and right image edges. Genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel. Only the ribbon is visible; no card, paper, backdrop, or cast shadows outside the ribbon. Landscape 1536x1024. Front view flat lay. The bow knot is centered at exactly x50%, y50%. Two beautiful asymmetric natural silk loops span approximately x30% to x70%. Short loose ribbon tails fall downward and stay within the central 50% of the image width. Straight horizontal ribbon bands are 9% of image height thick, centered at y50%, and extend all the way to the left and right image edges. Entire bow and tails fit inside the central 76% of image height, leaving generous transparent upper and lower margins. True woven silk satin, natural dimensional folds, subtle specular highlights, high fidelity textile detail, luxurious modern stationery styling. Muted warm champagne gold, approximately #bda074. No text, objects, glitter, ornamental patterns, illustration, cartoon, or fake checkerboard transparency.
assets.inspection: Accepted first attempt. True alpha background, natural satin bow. Knot slightly above image center; compensated through placement. Optimized to 1400px wide WebP retaining alpha.
